mentions.name: rho
mentions.description: A coding agent written in Rust that incorporates a Deno runtime for extensions. It is headless via JSON-RPC and has the beginnings of a trait-based system to enable different frontends; an extension for `pi` currently lets it be used as a frontend.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m iterating on my own coding agent, called `rho`. https://github.com/crustyrustacean/rho-coding-agent.git.
